title.en: Width, height and a centre crop

t.zh: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>：NumPy 给出图的形状时先写行数（高）、再写列数（宽）；OpenCV 要尺寸时却先写宽、再写高。Workshop 2 要从图的正中间裁出一块，两种顺序一混，裁出的位置就偏了。
t.en: <wiki-ref to="opencv-size-vs-numpy-shape"></wiki-ref>: NumPy gives an image's shape as rows (height) first, then columns (width); OpenCV asks for a size as width first, then height. Workshop 2 crops a region from the very centre, and mixing the two orders puts it off-centre.

t.zh: 这一关的问题是：已知形状 (rows, cols)，正中间那一块的左上角在哪？
t.en: This level asks: given the shape (rows, cols), where is the centre region's top-left corner?

after.zh: 形状先高后宽，尺寸先宽后高；<wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref>从余量的一半起。
after.en: A shape is height first, a size width first; a <wiki-ref to="center-crop-and-copy"></wiki-ref> starts half the spare room in.

brief.zh: 输入一张图、它的形状 rows、cols 和裁剪的宽 w、高 h：交出正中间的那一块。
brief.en: Given an image, its shape rows and cols, and the crop width w and height h, give the region at the very centre.

hint.zh: 横向的余量是哪个数减 w？
hint.en: The room left across is which number less w?

solution: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
naive: c = crop(image, x0, y0, w, h)
